title: Catalogs
purpose: See the lists of items clients may order with quantities on ticket forms, and open one to manage its items.
summary: The catalogs behind item-list fields, such as supplies or bottle kits. The product records what is ordered; the laboratory fills the order. Only the admin role can open this page.

tasks.title: Create a catalog
steps: Select [[New catalog]], name it and save.
On the catalog's page, select [[Add item]] for each thing clients may order.

tasks.title: Find out which forms use a catalog
steps: Read [[Used by fields]] in the table, then open the catalog to see the forms and fields.

tasks.title: Use a catalog on a form
steps: Open the ticket form, select [[Add field]], choose the type Items with quantities from a catalog and pick the catalog.

good_to_know: The product records the order a client sends. Picking, packing and shipping stay with the laboratory.
A catalog's counts include only active items and active fields.
The standard forms bring a starter supplies catalog. Load them from the ticket forms list.
Catalogs are switched off, not deleted. Tickets that ordered an item keep what was ordered.

items.label: New catalog
items.description: Opens the form to create a catalog. Only the admin role can use these pages. The Ticket forms link in the breadcrumbs returns to the forms list.

sections.title: Columns
paragraphs: Catalogs are listed by name, inactive ones included. There is no filtering or paging.

items.label: Catalog
items.description: The catalog's name. It opens the catalog. Inactive catalogs carry an Inactive mark.

items.label: Items
items.description: How many active items it holds.

items.label: Used by fields
items.description: How many active item-list fields use it.

items.label: Description
items.description: A staff note on what it holds. A dash when empty. Hidden first on narrow screens.

items.label: No catalogs yet
items.description: Shown when none exists. It offers New catalog and mentions the standard forms.
